definitions.hr: 60000 / mean RR (ms), lead II R peaks; NaN if < 2 R peaks
definitions.rr_sdnn: SD of RR intervals (ms, ddof=1); NaN if < 3 R peaks
definitions.rr_rmssd: root mean square of successive RR differences (ms); NaN if < 3 R peaks
definitions.rr_pnn50: fraction of successive RR differences > 50 ms; NaN if < 3 R peaks
definitions.rr_range: max RR - min RR (ms); NaN if < 3 R peaks
definitions.rr_cv: rr_sdnn / mean RR; NaN if < 3 R peaks
definitions.p_consistency: median Pearson correlation, over all pairs of beats, of the cleaned signal from 250 ms to 60 ms before each lead-II R peak (beats whose region starts before the crop are skipped); NaN if < 2 such beats
definitions.af_power_ratio: Welch power 4-9 Hz / power 1-40 Hz after masking 120 ms around each R peak
definitions.af_dom_freq: frequency of maximum Welch power in 3-12 Hz (Hz), same masked signal
definitions.af_peak_ratio: max Welch power in 4-6 Hz / median Welch power in 3-12 Hz, same masked signal
definitions.r_amp: median cleaned amplitude at the lead-II R peak times (µV); NaN if no R peak

cleaning: neurokit2.ecg_clean(method='neurokit') per lead; R peaks: neurokit2.ecg_peaks(method='neurokit') on cleaned lead II
